# coolify_project (Resource)

A Coolify project. Projects group environments, which in turn hold applications, databases and services.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_project" "example" {
  name        = "my-project"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the project.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description.

### Read-Only

- `uuid` (String) Server-assigned identifier of the project.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coolify_project.example <project-uuid>
```
